nodes.name: Nightly
nodes.notes:
Nightly rather than every five minutes, and its own workflow rather than a branch of an existing tick. The plan said "the materialiser runs on the existing nightly tick" and there is no such thing: rhythm_tick and notifications_sweep fire every five minutes, and meeting_alerts_reconcile is Notifications' own job. A five-minute pulse would need a claimed date to stop this walking every member's fortnight all day; a nightly schedule needs no claim, because the pass is idempotent -- the session ids are derived, so creating one is an upsert.

What it exists for is the day nothing happens. A slot is a weekly rule, so the far edge of `training.materialiseDays` has to be filled by something even on a quiet week -- and that is the whole of FR-008's second half: week four of a four-week program is filled on the day the horizon reaches it, not at apply time. Every actual change to a member's sports, slots or program is already materialised the moment its event is relayed.

03:40 rather than 03:00 or 03:20: the sweep fires on every fifth minute, the backup runs on the hour and the meeting-alert reconcile has 03:20. There is nothing to gain from landing on the same minute as any of them.

nodes.name: Run Now
nodes.notes: The way a person runs the pass without waiting until tomorrow morning -- and the way the phase gate runs it, since calling /internal/* directly is the right thing for a gate to do. Unconditional on purpose: it takes no input and the pass is idempotent, so running it twice by hand creates nothing twice.

nodes.name: Materialise
nodes.notes:
`BOTVY_SERVICE_TOKEN` and `BOTVY_API_BASE` are the names the other three cron workflows read and the names compose sets -- the pair once disagreed (`BOTVY_INTERNAL_TOKEN` in compose, `BOTVY_SERVICE_TOKEN` here), which is an empty `Bearer ` and a silent 401 nobody noticed for days. Reading them at all needs `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE: 'false'`, which compose sets: n8n blocks `$env` inside node expressions by default, and until that was set every execution of every cron workflow here failed with `access to env vars denied`.

Five minutes of timeout because this walks every member who has a weekly slot; three tries a quarter-minute apart because a retry is free -- the pass is idempotent.

`neverError` is off deliberately. A 401 or a 500 has to FAIL here so the error workflow fires and the heartbeat `training.materialise` goes stale, which is what /health reports after fifteen minutes.

nodes.name: Counts
nodes.notes: Kept as the execution's output so n8n's own log is the record of what each night's pass did. Note the counters are incremented as each member returns, so a member whose pass threw leaves these short while whatever it saved before throwing stands -- read the sessions, not this line, when asking what a 03:40 pass actually created. A steady-state night is all zeroes except `members` and `ms`, because a second pass over an unchanged week writes nothing.
